title: CONTROL: a destroyed pool's node goes on APR's own free list, so the system allocator never sees it end; the nested adapter revokes it at the release
control_for: the virtual-malloc and virtual-nested-pools arms of httpd/apr-pool-repros

virtual-malloc.oracle: complete: apr_pool_destroy files the node on the allocator's free list; virtual mallocng sees no free

virtual-nested-pools.oracle: fault at read_probe: aprp_node_release revoked the node's issued child (CREVOKE)
